name: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Stand with a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms facing each other and feet set for a squat.
Bend your hips and knees to squat while keeping the dumbbells at your shoulders.
Drive up through your legs and use the momentum to press both weights overhead.
Lower the weights to your shoulders before starting the next squat.
tips: Keep your heels planted as you descend.
Finish with the weights balanced above your shoulders and your ribs stacked over your pelvis.
